card.expiring: Your WhatsApp connection needs to be renewed soon. Press Reconnect to keep auto-replies running.

billing.summary: Meta, not HatchGrab, bills your WhatsApp account for replies. From {from} the first {free, number} a month are free. Correct as of {checked}; check <link>Meta’s pricing</link> for changes.

disconnect.body: Auto-replies stop right away and HatchGrab loses access to your WhatsApp account. Your number keeps working in the WhatsApp Business app. To remove HatchGrab completely, also open WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → Business Platform.

signup.needsRegistering: Your account is linked, but this number needs to be registered by us before replies can start. Please contact support — your setup is saved, do not run it again.
signup.numberTaken: That WhatsApp number is already connected to another HatchGrab account. A number can only answer for one truck. Contact support and we will move it over.
